import os
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53449/1_53449_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/53449_0_73834e71/1_53449_output.xlsx"

# Read the source data
df = pd.read_excel(spreadsheet_path, sheet_name="Sheet1")

def norm(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return ""
    return str(val).strip().lower()

def is_office_visit(val):
    v = norm(val)
    return "office" in v and "visit" in v

def is_covid_vaccine(val):
    v = norm(val)
    return "covid" in v and "vaccine" in v

def is_covid_test(val):
    v = norm(val)
    return "covid" in v and "test" in v

# Categorize visits at the patient/date level so rows from the same daily patient visit
# receive the same pivot-friendly category.
group_cols = ["Svc_Date", "Patient ID"]

categories = []

    proc_cats = group["Procedure Category ID"]

    has_office = proc_cats.apply(is_office_visit).any()
    has_vaccine = proc_cats.apply(is_covid_vaccine).any()
    has_test = proc_cats.apply(is_covid_test).any()

    if has_office and has_test:
        categories.append("Office Visits with a Covid Test")
